searchText: Has there been thought put into deprecating _precompiles_, such as the blake precompile? (Would need to do some chain analysis to see if it's called) There's been a lot of talk about changing the behavior of SELFDESTRUCT, but I have one question. As I see it, either the opcode should be fully removed, or the opcode's behavior should be changed without making any backward incompatible changes. Wouldn't proposals like https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-6046 simply be the worst of both worlds?
